SCOPE_001.template: Input scope: one selected 2D CT image is being summarized; this is not a complete CT volume.

TARGET_PRESENT_001.template: Target lesion evidence: the model produced a non-empty target-opacity prediction.

TARGET_EMPTY_001.template: Target lesion evidence: no target opacity detected by the model.

MEAS_EXTENT_001.template: Supported measurement: predicted lesion extent is {lesion_pixels} pixels on the original 512 × 512 image grid.

MEAS_WITHHELD_001.template: Supported measurement: numerical lesion extent is withheld because this case does not pass the source-derived p80 uncertainty eligibility gate.

GATE_PASS_001.template: Reliability status: this case passes the source-derived p80 uncertainty eligibility gate.

GATE_FAIL_001.template: Reliability status: this case does not pass the source-derived p80 uncertainty eligibility gate.

LIMIT_GEOMETRY_001.template: Physical lesion area and lesion volume are unavailable because verified physical geometry is not established.

LIMIT_LUNG_001.template: Whole-lung involvement is unavailable because a deployable lung-mask denominator is not available.

LIMIT_ORIENTATION_001.template: Laterality and lobar localization are not emitted because the required orientation and anatomical prerequisites are unavailable.

LIMIT_STABILITY_001.template: A true four-view lesion-extent stability range is unavailable because the individual aligned view predictions were not preserved.

LIMIT_RESEARCH_001.template: This is a research summary of model-derived evidence and is not a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
